messages:
morgan: Heads-up — AcmeCorp flagged a compliance requirement: some requests from their org need to egress directly to their partner proxy instead of going through our normal routing. They're asking for a per-org bypass. Can we discuss safety/telemetry implications?
javier: Uh — do they mean full bypass (no RW runtime in the path) or just bypass routing decision (still pass through for billing/telemetry)?
anika: They want direct egress (partner intercepts), but still want usage accounting on their invoice. So we need a way to count tokens even if the response path is different.
priya: This rings alarm bells for observability. If we let traffic skip the runtime, we lose traces, model metadata, and our QA fallbacks. How would we detect failures? :thinking_face:
sasha: Two approaches: 1) Proxy-level header that marks "egress-bypass" and still sends a lightweight telemetry poke to our ingest, or 2) a strict allowlist where bypass only works for specific endpoints + preflight webhook for audit.
helena: For enterprise customers we already have allowlists, but those are about inbound. This is outbound egress override. We need an audit trail (who enabled, when), TTL on the override, and a UI entry in Console.
javier: UI changes are fine but engineering questions: where do we authorize the bypass? Best place is API Gateway at routing stage. If header present + org in bypass ACL -> route to external target. But we must prevent spoofing.
anika: Prevent spoofing by requiring signed directive from our control plane. Example: X-RW-Egress: org=acme;exp=1719920000;sig=abc123
morgan: +1 on signed header. Also require that the signed directive is issued only by the admin flow in Console. No ad-hoc headers accepted from clients.
priya: What about quotas? If they bypass runtime, tokens consumed by model still need to decrement quota and increment billing metrics.
sasha: We can enforce quota at gateway level pre-egress. Flow: request hits gateway -> verify signed override -> deduct quota/emit metric -> forward to partner endpoint with minimal RW headers removed. That keeps billing and audit intact.
helena: We also need fallback rules. If partner returns 5xx, should we silently fall back to our hosted model, or fail closed? Product wants graceful fallback to hosted for critical flows.
javier: Fallbacks complicate data residency/compliance (if they wanted partner-only egress for legal reasons). We should make fallback configurable per-exception (fail-open vs fail-closed) and surface that as a required setting in the request flow.
anika: Logging: ensure we emit an event for every bypass attempt that includes org, directive id, target host, decision (allowed/denied), and final outcome. Those events should be indexed in our audit log with retention + export option.
priya: Telemetry: add a new metric series eg: ingress.requests.egress_bypass{org, result, target}. Also trace samples: a synthetic trace that shows gateway->partner latency but redact PII.
morgan: UX: Console needs a managed "Org Egress Overrides" page where customer admins can add/remove targets, set expiry, and set fallback policy. Internal SREs need a toggle to revoke immediately.
sasha: Safety check: only allow bypass for customers on paid enterprise tiers, and add an enforcement gate that prevents it in hosted self-serve orgs.
helena: Rollout plan: alpha with 1-2 trusted customers behind an internal flag, collect telemetry, ensure billing reconciliation works. Then beta > GA.
javier: Can we demo a signed directive format now? Example:

```
X-RW-EGRESS: v1;org=acme;target=https://partner.acme/proxy;exp=1719920000;flags=fail-closed;sig=MEUCIQ...;
```

morgan: Good. Implement checklist: (1) Gateway routing + signed verification, (2) quota decrement + billing emit, (3) audit event + retention, (4) Console UI + admin issuance flow, (5) fallback policy enforcement, (6) internal revoke API.
anika: I'll draft the gateway PR for signature verification and metric emission. Want to include a small e2e harness to simulate partner latency/failure modes.
priya: I'll add the audit schema and billing hooks. Need a small design doc to confirm fields and cardinality for metrics.
sasha: I'll own Console UX and admin flows. We'll need permissions: workspace owners and customers' security contacts can create directives.
deploy-bot: deploy-status: ci/gateway/signed-egress-checks passing on branch feature/egress-bypass (build 3112) :white_check_mark:
morgan: Thanks all. Next steps: an RFC by EOD Friday with example headers, console mockups, and rollout gating criteria. Tagging @javier @anika @sasha for drafts. :rocket:
